system.name: PR-IQA
system.one_liner: Partial-reference image quality assessment that scores diffusion-generated novel views against references from other poses, and guides 3DGS training with the quality maps.

content.variant_note: three lettered tinted panels as consecutive stages (generate views, assess their quality, train 3DGS with the maps), all on one statue scene
content.argues: A dense quality map predicted from unaligned references, close to full-reference metrics and needing no ground truth, lets 3DGS train only on trustworthy regions of diffusion-made views.
content.subject: A statue scene carried from reference views through diffusion-made novel views, quality maps of several IQA methods, and 3DGS renders.

elements.drawn_as: two photos framed in blue with an ellipsis between them

elements.name: Dense Stereo

elements.name: Point-rendered Novel View

elements.name: Video Diffusion Model

elements.name: Refined Novel View

elements.name: Ground Truth, Query Image, Reference Image

elements.drawn_as: three equal photos, the query framed green and the reference framed orange-yellow

elements.name: Only Query Image: FR-IQA DINOv2, NR-IQA PIQE

elements.drawn_as: black-outlined rounded box under a black pill, two heat maps with white tags FR-IQA and NR-IQA

elements.name: Only Overlapped Region: CR-IQA MEt3R

elements.name: Query + Reference Images + Patch-level: CrossScore, PuzzleSim
elements.role: cross-reference baselines using query and reference at patch level
elements.drawn_as: black-outlined rounded box under a black pill with coloured words, two maps tagged CR-IQA

elements.name: Query + Ref. + Pixel-level: Ours

elements.name: Quality-Conditioned Sampling: Aligned, Misaligned
elements.role: image-level selection of candidate pseudo-ground-truths by quality
elements.drawn_as: two thumbnails with yellow labels, a green tick under Aligned and a red cross under Misaligned

elements.name: Masked Training Loss: Quality Map, Loss Mask
elements.role: pixel-level filtering: the quality map becomes a binary mask that restricts the loss
elements.drawn_as: rainbow heat map beside a black-and-white mask with captions below

elements.name: Ground Truth, Vanilla 3DGS, PuzzleSim, Ours
elements.role: 3DGS renders from training with no filtering, a baseline filter and the proposed filter, next to the true view

content.reading_order: Starts at the Reference Views at the top left of (a), follows the elbow arrows down to the refined view, then continues with (b) from the three photos to the groups of quality maps ending in Ours, and finishes in (c) with the mask and the renders.

layout.arrangement_note: Three tinted rounded panels side by side, each with a bold lettered title at the top left: grey (a), light blue (b), cream (c). Panel (a) is a vertical chain of boxes joined by black elbow arrows. Panel (b) has a row of three photos above four black-outlined groups of heat maps in a two-by-two arrangement, each under a black header pill. Panel (c) has two small thumbnail rows above a two-by-two grid of renders. No arrows join the panels.

new_tags.name: input-pills-on-method-groups

lessons.what_to_learn: When methods differ by the inputs they use, group their output tiles in outlined boxes under a black pill that names the inputs, and colour the input words like the frames of the input photos, so the reader sees what each method gets without reading a table.
lessons.suits: Evaluation or quality-assessment papers where several baselines differ by which inputs or references they use, shown on one scene.

evidence: Diffusion models generate novel views (pseudo-GTs) from sparse inputs, which often contain photometric or geometric artifacts.
This quality map enables a dual-filtering strategy (image selection and pixel masking) for 3DGS training
its dense quality map creates a binary confidence mask

summary: PR-IQA scores diffusion-generated novel views against reference views from other poses, without ground truth, and uses the quality maps to train 3D Gaussian Splatting only on trustworthy regions. Figure 1 shows three tinted lettered panels on one statue scene. (a) Reference views go through dense stereo to point-rendered novel views with unobserved holes, which a video diffusion model inpaints. (b) Photos framed green for the query and orange for the reference, then quality maps of full-, no- and cross-reference methods (DINOv2, PIQE, MEt3R, CrossScore, PuzzleSim) against Ours, grouped under black pills that name the inputs each uses. (c) Aligned and misaligned candidates with a tick and a cross, the quality map and loss mask, and 3DGS renders from Ground Truth, Vanilla 3DGS, PuzzleSim and Ours.

notes: The prior primary kind contribution-mosaic is dropped: the lettered panels are consecutive stages (generate, assess, train) on one scene, so stage-pipeline leads, side-by-side-contrast covers the method comparisons in (b) and (c), and worked-walkthrough the single scene carried through. The yellow state labels are live text on the images. The colour scale of the heat maps is not explained in the figure.
